items.title_orig: I love getting to watch Billy retell all these stories to the people they’re about
items.article_text:
Getting to tell Edgar Winter about his mom playing White Trash for him on acid, him winning the 4th grade talent show for “Elderly Woman Behind The Counter In A Small Town” and getting to play it with Pearl Jam, and now his dad shouting him into the bedroom for some David Grisman discipline. 
 It just warms my heart.
